hud.hint: WASD: walk     SPACE: sword     E: talk     ESC: pause

npc.hello: Careful, stranger. These cellars are full of grunts.
npc.door: A locked door bars the way to the stairs. Find the key first.
npc.advice: Swing your sword with SPACE and keep moving. Torchlight is your friend. Take 20 gold for the road.
npc.again: I have told you all I know. Go on.
npc.bye: Then good luck, and mind the dark.

credits.title: CREDITS
credits.text:
Depths is a small game made to test the Lunaris engine: every level, picture and sound was made by scripts that call the engine's tools. No outside art.

Engine: Lunaris
Design, art, sound and rules: written as data and Lunaris Script
